rivet.intro: Straighten red tie, roll shoulders and raise a confident guard.
rivet.special: Four advancing alternating punches, pronounced coiled windup and full-body finishing cross.
rivet.cast: Cheeks inflate, chin draws back, horizontal golden spit release, mouth relaxes.
rivet.recoil: Chest hit bends sternum back while feet brace, then tucked return.
rivet.defeat: Stagger, try to straighten tie, knees buckle, fall sideways and settle with face visible.

vela.intro: Round bare belly inhale, open red-lipped smile, settle wide blue feet.
vela.special: Deep full-body inhale, plant feet, release a long straight prism breath, recoil and settle.
vela.cast: Round cheek puff and lips purse before a straight blue spit, feet stay planted.
vela.recoil: Soft belly compresses, shoulders rock back, feet catch the weight.
vela.defeat: Belly wobble, sit down heavily, tired backward recline with both feet and face visible.

bront.intro: Muscular double-biceps flex, lower fists into heavy guard.
bront.special: Compress hips, two-handed overhead hammer, rising force and double-palm ground slam.
bront.cast: Brace muscular torso and push a heavy boulder from both palms.
bront.recoil: Broad chest absorbs hit, shoulders twist and knees brace.
bront.defeat: Strong stance falters, fists sink, one knee drops, chest tips onto side with arms relaxed.

zephyr.intro: Present one pumpkin with sly grin, tuck it away and guard. No miniature companion.
zephyr.special: Circle pumpkin overhead, underhand lob, overhead harvest slam, recover.
zephyr.cast: Underhand pumpkin scoop and forward release with a trailing wrist.
zephyr.recoil: Red-clad torso twists, yellow collar stays connected, heels catch.
zephyr.defeat: Attempt to catch a falling pumpkin, knees fold, slump beside the pumpkin without dismemberment.

mox.intro: Show fangs briefly, measured fencing salute, settle long guard.
mox.special: Five precise long-arm thrusts with changing shoulder lead and an extended final lunge.
mox.cast: Pinch a small dart, cock wrist, flick forward and recover.
mox.recoil: Lean torso recoils in a narrow S curve, balanced retreat step.
mox.defeat: Final exhausted salute, knees bend, tip sideways with feline head upright then resting.

rune.intro: Both joined faces glance in turn, adjust suit, raise palms.
rune.special: Hands orbit a gravity core, pull inward then spread in a wide night burst.
rune.cast: Cup palms around an orb, spiral wrists, push orb forward.
rune.recoil: Joined head remains one connected form, torso rotates under it and returns.
rune.defeat: Both expressions sag, loosen knees, seated collapse with joined face intact.

guest07.intro: Roll shoulders, purse thick red lips, alternate fists into guard.
guest07.special: Low shoulder dip, advancing uppercuts, high stretched final uppercut, controlled recovery.
guest07.cast: Large layered lips compress, cheeks fill, release straight citrus spit.
guest07.recoil: Long neck and lip mass stay attached as chest arches and recovers.
guest07.defeat: Lips droop, stagger one step, hands catch floor, roll to side with no duplicate arms.

guest08.intro: Show three rounded teeth, swing a ring once, catch and guard.
guest08.special: Wide ring cast, torso follow-through, catch return behind shoulder and sweep back.
guest08.cast: Wrist winds a ring and releases forward, then open catching hand.
guest08.recoil: Large goggles/head turn with shoulders; red suit creases at hips.
guest08.defeat: Reach for returning ring and miss, drop into seated slump, ring rests beside hand.

guest09.intro: Dust black shirt motif, red spiky head nod, fists up.
guest09.special: Driving cross, advancing shoulder turn, third full-body redline punch and brake.
guest09.cast: Pull fist to waist, punch an accelerating arrow-shaped shot forward.
guest09.recoil: Red spiky head tilts with neck, chest recoils and stabilizes.
guest09.defeat: Forward momentum stumbles, hands touch knees, collapse to side with shirt motif preserved.

guest10.intro: Adjust Christmas hat brim/pom-pom, cheerful wave, guard.
guest10.special: Produce a gift, lift overhead, four festive hammer/lob accents, guard.
guest10.cast: Cradle gift at chest, two-handed gift-box toss, open fingers and recover.
guest10.recoil: Hat follows head with delayed soft tip while blue torso braces.
guest10.defeat: Hat slips but stays on, sink to knees, sit and droop forward with visible pom-pom.

guest11.intro: Touch pendant, face halves exchange expression, open-palmed guard.
guest11.special: Heart at chest, reaching palm drain, second expansive heart pulse, withdraw.
guest11.cast: Hands form heart briefly, push fluttering heart forward.
guest11.recoil: Split face stays joined and consistent, red shirt shoulders twist.
guest11.defeat: Clutch pendant, shoulders sink, crouch then curl on side; spiral ornament remains attached.

guest12.intro: Long neck turns toward opponent, adjust red collar, measured palms up.
guest12.special: Coin flip, three diagonal addressing palm strikes, sweeping last hand.
guest12.cast: Flip coin with thumb then flick it forward low.
guest12.recoil: Long neck forms a controlled arc, no head detachment, torso catches up.
guest12.defeat: Coin falls from palm, long neck lowers, sit and lean back with continuous neck.

guest13.intro: Flare open coat hem subtly, red brow lifts, loose hook guard with visible neck.
guest13.special: Coiling torso windup, long hook sweep, inward spiral pull, sharp outward release.
guest13.cast: Head draws back above connected neck, purse lips and emit straight serpent spit.
guest13.recoil: Coat swings with shoulders; visible neck remains between jaw and collar.
guest13.defeat: Coat folds around bent knees, one hand on chest, seated side slump with neck visible.

guest14.intro: Four pupils glance, white-gloved hands snap into jaunty guard.
guest14.special: Three distinct phase-step lunges, quick white-palmed strikes and a sharp stop.
guest14.cast: Arrange a small pixel cluster between palms, push it forward.
guest14.recoil: Four-pupil eyes widen, gloved hands brace, body snaps back and settles.
guest14.defeat: Flicker is an external effect only; body staggers, knees give way, flat side collapse with all limbs present.

dumpstar.intro: Adjust tie and yellow shirt cuffs, roll wrists into workman guard; no shoulder props.
dumpstar.special: Low sweeping scoop, heavy ground strike, cleanup push across floor.
dumpstar.cast: Crouch and scoop ground debris forward with one broad hand.
dumpstar.recoil: Yellow shirt folds at waist, head and tie trail the chest recoil.
dumpstar.defeat: Exhausted hands on knees, tie hangs, kneel then lie on side; no objects above shoulders.

crapto.intro: Adjust yellow goggles, bare blue chest inhale, long lips curl into guard.
crapto.special: Goggles glint, acid charge at lips, three siphoning breath pulses, settle.
crapto.cast: Long lips pucker and extend slightly, horizontal acid spit, chin recoils.
crapto.recoil: Lean torso recoils, goggles remain on face, feet slide into brace.
crapto.defeat: Goggles tilt but remain worn, knees tremble, hands catch floor then side rest.

vamp.intro: Deadpan downward glance, shrug black jacket, one slow hand raises.
vamp.special: Clutch heart, dramatic inward fold, three broken-heart pulses, tired outward palm and sigh.
vamp.cast: Head dips, one palm releases broken heart while shoulders express a sigh.
vamp.recoil: Small restrained flinch, jacket collar connected, shoulders close inward.
vamp.defeat: Slow melancholy kneel, hand over heart, slump sideways with deadpan face. No self-harm imagery.

alpha777.intro: Adjust blue goggles/red scarf, flip imaginary lucky token, grin and guard.
alpha777.special: Count three finger beats, rapid six jackpot hand impacts, triumphant open hand.
alpha777.cast: Trace a seven with finger then snap it forward.
alpha777.recoil: Scarf follows olive torso, goggles stay aligned with eyes.
alpha777.defeat: Look at empty palm, shoulders fall, sit cross-legged then exhausted side slump.

mandela.intro: Lift chin, broad open-hand salute, connected long reach into guard.
mandela.special: Cast linked energy, pull strongly with both arms, release in a wide freedom-chain arc.
mandela.cast: Gather chain links between palms and throw one hand forward.
mandela.recoil: Radial head spikes retain shape, collar and neck pivot together.
mandela.defeat: Hands slowly open, one knee touches floor, settle on side with radial spikes intact.

bigswole.intro: Tap chest, flex and set shoulders; white eyes and crescent earring stay clear.
bigswole.special: Deep hip compression, huge upward fist, overhead double-arm crash and low recovery.
bigswole.cast: Lift heavy rock from hip and shove forward with both arms.
bigswole.recoil: Broad chest twists, hips and knees absorb impact without a central leg spike.
bigswole.defeat: Attempt last flex, knees buckle, heavy seated fall then side rest; clean gap between legs.

nate.intro: Small bouncing foot shuffle, wide blue-toothed grin, crouched pounce guard.
nate.special: Three short connected pounces with exaggerated paw reach and planted recovery.
nate.cast: Crouch, swipe a low paw-shaped shot forward, recoil back onto feet.
nate.recoil: Small torso compresses with yellow hood/spikes following head, feet stay distinct.
nate.defeat: Tiny stagger steps, sit with feet forward, curl onto side while blue face remains visible.
